svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 01 · Santa Barbara · 04/12 The Lagoon (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A tidal lagoon the campus wraps around. Herons stand very still in it. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
